description: Germany only. Mini-job check under German law (Minijob, geringfügige Beschäftigung, § 8 SGB IV) for 2026 and 2027: maximum hours under the monthly earnings limit, minimum wage check (Mindestlohn), annual limit including one-off payments, and the employer's flat-rate contributions and levies (Pauschalabgaben). Use it before hiring a mini-jobber or changing hours or pay. Germany only.

einmalzahlungen_jahr.description: Promised one-off payments in the year in euros, e.g. Christmas bonus

gesetzlich_krankenversichert.description: True (default) if the person has statutory health insurance; then the employer pays the 13 % health flat rate

pauschsteuer.description: True (default) for the usual 2 % flat-rate tax

stunden.description: Planned working hours, leave out to get only the maximum hours

stunden_je.description: Whether the hours are per week or per month, default week

unter_18_ohne_berufsabschluss.description: True if the person is under 18 without vocational qualification; then the minimum wage does not apply (§ 22 Abs. 2 MiLoG)

name: minijob
title: Minijob: Stunden, Grenze und Kosten
